text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Yay♪ An airmail letter from Dad!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Could it be word on their next trip to 
Japan? Maybe there are show tickets 
inside—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
"To Laurel. Regarding the fashion show in 
Japan, it has been cancelled. Therefore, 
my trip to Japan is—"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Aww, I see... Well, it can't be helped 
this time. But—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah! To make up for it, I'm gonna 
video call you a ton today!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Sakura Laurel felt deeply disappointed at 
losing a precious chance to see her 
father.
